overall.summary: Deterministic contract is unscoped. 1 evidence-backed blocker(s); 2 advisory taste note(s).
overall.raw_summary: The HUD is functional but has several issues with spacing, alignment, and readability. Improvements are needed in visual hierarchy, spacing balance, and typography clarity to enhance usability and polish.

strengths: The HUD elements are generally placed in expected locations (e.g., minimap in the top-right, health bar in the bottom-left).
The layout is clean and avoids excessive clutter.
issues: The minimap is not optically centered within its container, appearing slightly off to the right.
The 'Floor 1' and timer panel is not aligned with the center of the screen, creating a visual imbalance.

strengths: The spacing between ability slots is consistent.
issues: The 'Auto Abilities' label is too close to the top of its container, leaving insufficient breathing room (approx. 2px gap).
The health bar text ('250 / 250') is cramped vertically, with minimal padding above and below the text.

strengths: The minimap and health bar are visually distinct and easy to locate.
issues: The 'Floor 1' and timer panel lacks emphasis and does not stand out as a key piece of information.
The 'Auto Abilities' section does not clearly differentiate between active and inactive abilities, making it harder to prioritize actions.

strengths: The pixel font is generally legible and consistent with the game's pixel art style.
issues: The text in the health bar ('250 / 250') is small and could be difficult to read for some players.
The 'Auto Abilities' numbers (1-9) are small and lack contrast against their background.

strengths: Icons for currency and health are clear and recognizable.
issues: The minimap lacks any markers or labels, reducing its utility.
The ability slots do not use icons, which could make them harder to identify at a glance.

strengths: The pixel font is thematically appropriate and consistent across the HUD.
issues: Text in the 'Auto Abilities' section is too small and lacks sufficient padding, reducing clarity.
The 'Floor 1' and timer text is not visually distinct enough to draw attention.

strengths: The pixel art style is consistent across the HUD elements.
The color palette aligns well with the game's aesthetic.
issues: The 'Auto Abilities' section feels overly utilitarian and could benefit from more thematic embellishments.

blocking_findings: The 'Auto Abilities' numbers (1-9) are too small and lack sufficient contrast, reducing readability.

Increase the size and contrast of the numbers in the 'Auto Abilities' section.
Center the 'Floor 1' and timer panel horizontally to improve visual balance.
Add markers or labels to the minimap to enhance its utility.
